description: Bridge to the MIDI Thing v2 hardware: twelve CV inputs sent out over MIDI to the unit's twelve assignable ports

params.text: Puts the connected MIDI Thing into the preset built for Rack and copies the current settings and voltage ranges over to it, one way only

inputs.text: A control voltage sent over MIDI to the matching port on the hardware; right-click its box on the panel to pick the range it expects, from 0-10V, -5V to 5V, 0-8V or 0-5V

notes: the hardware expects control voltages here, not audio-rate signals
this module makes no sound and no voltage of its own: it sends MIDI to a MIDI Thing v2 unit. Plug the hardware in, pick it under Select MIDI Device, then press SYNC.
menu: Select MIDI Device — lists each MIDI driver and, under it, the output devices it offers, and picks the one the module sends to
All channels MIDI update rate — sets the total rate shared between the active channels: 250Hz, 500Hz, 1kHz, 2kHz, 4kHz or 8kHz
Set mode for all channels — puts every port on the same voltage range in one go: 0 to 10v, -5 to 5v, 0 to 8v or 0 to 5v
Per-channel MIDI update rate — a line of text, not a setting, showing what each active channel gets once the total rate is shared out
